purpose: Review the 127 accepted V48 Abu Dhabi projects without verified points against the AD-SDI Developer Projects polygon layer.

adSdiDeveloperGeometry.geometryGrain: source feature polygon, not a verified V48 project point

method: Compare whitespace-trimmed, case-folded exact project names among the 127 unmapped V48 projects and all 411 AD-SDI source features; review developer labels and source geometry before exposing a relationship. No polygon centroid is converted into a V48 coordinate.

exactNameCandidates.reason: Names and developer labels align. The AD-SDI polygon covers a named masterplan; the V48 ADREC record is a plot project in area E48. The source evidence does not establish identical parcel geometry or a precise project point.
Developer names disagree; the shared name alone is insufficient for a relationship or coordinate.

limits: This is a bounded cross-source identity review, not a complete geocoding exercise. The AD-SDI source geometry can be returned by source object ID, but remains distinct from accepted V48 project coordinates and registered sale or rent evidence.
